name: writer-notes
description: The checks a commit waits for (npm run verify): Agent Note gates, the prototype, DESIGN.md, go vet with the toolkit's vet, and go test. The product is the Go module.

scripts.verify-notes: node scripts/verify-agent-note-tree.ts && node scripts/verify-agent-note-format.ts && node scripts/verify-archived-agent-notes.ts
scripts.verify-prototype: node scripts/prototype/locales.ts --check && node --test scripts/prototype/browser.test.ts && node scripts/verify-prototype.ts
